summary: The shared Bright Data budget gate now rejects bool, non-integer and non-finite values before any provider call, while accepted requests still include num_of_posts. The paid snapshot creation POST uses the existing request helper with attempts=1, preventing automatic duplicate submission after a lost acknowledgement, and CLI help now describes the required positive bound. Three regression tests were red before the fix and all 10 pipeline tests are green; the existing allowed-request test also verifies the budget notice is present before triggering and contains no token. README documents retry behavior and the two unresolved recovery/migration limitations.
